about: What the Angles audio library should contain. Make one file per entry, name it after the id, drop it in <source>/music or <source>/sfx, and run tools/audio-library/build.mjs.
musicBrief: Instrumental only, no vocals or vocal samples. One steady tempo from start to finish, with a drum or percussion pulse a listener can tap along to. Start sparse. At about 20 seconds the drums and bass come in and the track opens up clearly; it lifts again at about 50 seconds. At least 100 seconds long. No long intro, and end on a held note rather than a fade.
